---
title: "Stata workshops"
---

Four workshops, in the order to take them:

1. [Stata Introduction](intro.qmd): the interface and do-files, reading and writing data, summary statistics, basic graphs and data management. For people new to Stata.
2. Stata Data Management: generating and replacing variables, missing values, types, merging and appending, summary data sets. *Being converted.*
3. Stata Regression Models: models for continuous and binary outcomes, saving results, quantities of interest. *Being converted.*
4. Stata Graphics: univariate and bivariate graphs. *Being converted.*

Before any of them, follow the [installation page](install.qmd). Each workshop's page links to its materials (data, cheat sheets, a BLANK do-file to type along in, and the exercise solutions).
